issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Jama et al. — Order discussing the Indictment and search warrants, Doc. 173
notes: Primary federal court source summarizing the original ECF No. 1 indictment. The original indictment binary remains uncaptured in the corpus, but this order cites the indictment paragraphs supporting the charge structure.
supports: The court states that the 22-CR-225 Indictment charges Defendants with wire fraud, federal programs bribery, conspiracy to commit money laundering, and money laundering, citing Indictment paragraphs 48, 49, 51, 53, and 63.
The court's description contains no wire-fraud-conspiracy charge in the original Jama indictment.
The court states that the indictment alleges more than 1.7 million meals falsely claimed, about $5.6 million paid by MDE, and approximately $4.3 million received by Defendants.
does_not_support: That the original ECF No. 1 PDF itself has been captured in this corpus.
A network-wide conclusion about § 1349 in other Feeding Our Future charging instruments.
Adjudicated guilt from the indictment allegations.
